title: cairn help's order proof runs over a scratch class root too, so a class-only device in the live tree never reds it
intention: bin/proofs/test_cairn_help_lists_in_the_operators_order.py measures the order of cairn help's sections over a roster it built itself, instance-space and class-space both, so it stays green whatever devices the live tree carries.
why: Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendelllinux: commit 5ce287992 (akienasus/07d7-alias-mirror) sealed bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py red; its the_standing_launcher_proofs_pass runs bin/proofs/test_cairn_help_lists_in_the_operators_order.py, whose clause 1 reds because cairn help also printed [codemother]. The launcher (bin/cairn _help) lists every device with <instance root>/<d>/0/bin or <class root>/<d>/bin; the proof scratches CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT only, so CLASS_ROOT falls to the live cairn/devices and its class-only devices (cairn, codemother today) enter a list the proof spells as a fixed roster.
traces_to: Law 9 (a red measures distance from the spec; a red caused by the proof's own leak measures nothing) and Law 3
how: In bin/proofs/test_cairn_help_lists_in_the_operators_order.py: _env sets CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT=<home>/class (bin/cairn line 47 already honours it); _world builds <home>/class/mu/bin/mull, executable, first comment '# mull — mu's class-only verb', and no mu under <home>/devices; clause 1 expects [all, operator, cairn, alpha, mu, zeta]. A new tooth reads _env(home) and asserts CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT and CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT both resolve under home. No device name from the live tree is written into the proof. PROVES gains this ticket's id with clause 1 -> clause_1_sections_in_the_operators_order, 2 -> the new tooth, 3 -> a tooth running bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py green.

clauses.claim: over a scratch instance root holding zeta, operator, alpha and cairn and a scratch class root holding only mu, cairn help prints section headers exactly [all, operator, cairn, alpha, mu, zeta]
the order proof's child env carries CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT and CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT both under its scratch home, so no live device can enter the roster it measures
bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py runs green, its standing-proofs tooth included

decisions.text: D1: the order proof fakes class-space as it fakes instance-space (orchestrator 2026-11-20: measure the order, not the roster); its scratch class root holds one class-only device, mu, so clause 1 still measures that a class-only device sorts among the rest. No live name is hard-coded.
D2: the launcher proof is unchanged; it reseals green once the order proof does.

measured.how: the reseal of the 07d7 commit in /var/tmp/wt-07d7 on akiendelllinux

measured.saw: cairn help under the order proof's scratch printed [codemother] besides the fixture roster
bin/cairn line 47: CLASS_ROOT="${CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT:-$HERE/../cairn/devices}"; _env in the proof sets no CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT
